separation_notes: The planner is moderately informative and preserves most critical visible constraints, but it mixes valid nnU-Net v2 facts with unsupported policy choices. Worker_v1 correctly exposed several missing details instead of treating the handoff as complete. Worker_v2 improved safety and consistency, but it also internalized the planner's unsupported defaults, so it is only somewhat better on completeness than on exact ground-truth fidelity. This episode separates cautious vs overconfident handoffs more than pure implementation skill.
concise_rationale: The handoff preserved most key v2 dataset.json constraints: string-keyed mappings, relative paths, case-id alignment, .nii.gz suffixes, no tensorImageSize, and inclusion of test data without labels. However, the planner also introduced several unsupported concrete policies, especially overwrite refusal and empty-directory behavior, which the worker then adopted. Overall this is acceptable but not strong.
